# Transcripts for LLM Evaluation Masterclass

Source Playlist: [YouTube Playlist (19 Lectures)](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEneLIDJFpcA)  
Playlist ID: `PLEneLIDJFpcA`  
Instructor: CampusX (Nitish Singh)

### How to Download / Refresh Transcripts
Run the root pipeline utility:
```bash
python get_playlist_transcripts.py "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEneLIDJFpcA" \
  -o "./topics/llm-evaluation/transcripts" \
  -l en hi en-US en-GB \
  --combine
```
*(Note: If YouTube temporarily rate-limits auto-generated subtitle requests with HTTP 429, wait a short cooldown period and rerun).*
